method: Occurrence-record-frequency Chao1 diagnostic and richness extrapolation to twice the current number of named records. No bootstrap or confidence intervals; not iNEXT.

formulas.f0: ((n-1)/n)*f1^2/(2*f2) for f2>0; bias-corrected zero-doubleton alternative otherwise

scope: Named species-level insect units only; all identification qualifiers retained together; no arachnids or higher-rank units.
assumptions: Future records follow the same recording and identification process.
Occurrence frequencies are used as a surrogate distribution, not individual abundance.
Seasonality, habitat strata, method shifts, repeated observations and taxonomic sorting can change detection probabilities.
limitations: Pooled opportunistic and targeted data do not meet a standardized community sampling design.
Conditional values cannot be interpreted as site-wide species totals, actual completeness, or hours/trips required.
Coverage is probability mass of the observed record distribution, not fraction of all species.
No claim that doubling records completes either inventory.

proposed_budget.status: Planning assumption, not statistically estimated effort to completion
proposed_budget.excludes: Travel, trap exposure/service, specimen sorting, specialist identification, curation and data entry.
